entries.name: The Berserker

equipment.name: Pack containing gear to care for weapons and armor and establish camps when traveling

entries.notes: Large could become an Affinity or Puissant Great Weapon; another Flaw and a Virtue to match can be added. The Abilities at 1 or 2 can be moved around.
fixes: The page gives no Size line; Large makes it +1 (its Wound Penalties are in 6-point steps).

entries.name: The Grizzled Veteran

equipment.name: Pack containing gear to care for weapons and armor and establish camps when traveling

entries.notes: An informal leader of the grogs who talks back to the magi; age has already cost him Presence and Communication. He can take two more Flaws and matching Virtues; keep the high scores in combat, move the rest freely.

entries.name: The Hunter
entries.notes: Guides the party in the wilds, fights at range and brings in food, but is poor company. Bows uses Warrior's xp so stays at 4 or more; the other Abilities except the native language can be swapped.

entries.name: The Specialist

equipment.name: Pack containing gear to care for weapons and armor and establish camps when traveling

entries.notes: Can focus on a different Ability (swap the Characteristics and perhaps Warrior for Educated or Well-Traveled to suit). Personality Traits, Flaws and the other Ability scores can change freely.

entries.name: The Standard Soldier

equipment.name: Pack containing gear to care for weapons and armor and establish camps when traveling

entries.notes: The Weakness is yours to choose. A good base for a slightly unusual grog: add Virtues and Flaws and rearrange the Abilities.

entries.name: The Tough Guy

virtues_flaws.note: thinks he can't really be hurt

equipment.name: Pack containing gear to care for weapons and armor and establish camps when traveling

entries.notes: A magus's bodyguard who can take a lot of punishment. The Flaws can change freely, and his combat scores can be swapped between his combat Abilities.

entries.name: The Female Scholar

virtues_flaws.note: prove herself a greater scholar than any man
outspoken advocate of the abilities of women

equipment.name: A slate or wax tablet for writing on

entries.notes: Estranged from her family for choosing scholarship over marriage, she wants the covenant's library. One or two Virtues could shift to another side of her life, and her studies to another subject, as long as Artes Liberales stays at 1 or more so she can read.

entries.name: The Knight
entries.notes: Wealthy gives most of his xp, so changing it means rebuilding him. Oath of Fealty could be True Love (or both, with three Flaw points to spare). Proud makes him look down on nearly everyone.

entries.name: The Priest
entries.notes: Could take two more Minor Flaws and Virtues. His Lesser Immunity can change kind, or become a Greater Immunity with two more Minor Flaws.

entries.name: The Rogue

equipment.name: Secret stash of money that he never spends

entries.notes: The Dark Secret is most likely a past crime; the Compulsion a petty crime or risk-taking. Moving his Characteristic and Ability numbers can make him a charmer with some stealth (change the Great and Puissant Virtues to match).

entries.name: The Witch
entries.notes: An excellent healer without The Gift. Her Enemies could be intolerant clergy or a magical or faerie being (then perhaps Plagued by Supernatural Entity). She can take another Major Flaw or three Minor ones, with Virtues to match.
fixes: The page's "Divine Lore" is Dominion Lore, the Definitive Edition's name for it.

entries.name: Bjornaer

abilities.name: Guile
abilities.specialty: pretending to know less than you do

entries.notes: More at ease with animals than people (Blatant Gift with Inoffensive to Animals). Ways of the Forest should match the heartbeast (a wolf here). Both Major Flaws can change, and Deficient Ignem is common in the House but optional. Quiet and Subtle Magic let him cast in heartbeast form without penalty.

entries.name: Bonisagus
entries.notes: A lab rat Driven to a great discovery, pushed into stories by the favors he owes and by needing enchanted items he is bad at making. Built on the Virtues and Driven; the other Flaws change easily. He can take two more Minor Flaws (or make Driven Major) with two Minor Virtues. Changing the Affinities means changing his spells too.

entries.name: Criamon
entries.notes: Short of her full Flaws: she can take another Major Flaw or three Minor ones, with Virtues to match. Charm and Folk Ken (and her Presence) could move into other early-childhood Abilities.
fixes: The page's "Phantom of the Talking Head" is Phantasm of the Talking Head, as the Jerbiton template spells it.

Piercing the Magical Veil and Unravelling the Fabric of Imaginem are versions of Piercing the Faerie Veil and Unravelling the Fabric of (Form) (Chapter Nine); creating the character adds them to the saga's own spells.

entries.name: Ex Miscellanea
entries.notes: His tradition grants Giant Blood and Affinity with Terram and imposes Necessary Condition: touching a stone at least the size of his hand. He can take another Major Flaw or three Minor ones, with Virtues to match.
fixes: The page drops Perception's score ("Per -Pre -1"): -1 is the only score that spends exactly the 10 points Improved Characteristics allows (Strength and Stamina +4 include Giant Blood's +1).

entries.name: Flambeau

abilities.name: Guile
abilities.specialty: claiming not to have done something

equipment.name: Wizardly robes, smelling slightly of smoke

entries.notes: A one-trick pony: superb at throwing fire, with Penetration even for strong spells, and weak at anything else. Wrathful, Enemies and the Greater Immunity can be swapped out; he can take another Minor Flaw and Minor Virtue.

entries.name: Guernicus

virtues_flaws.note: no magic for Sun duration after lying

entries.notes: If she lies she can use no magic until the sun next rises or sets; anyone lying near her soon after she casts must pass a Personality check against the spell's magnitude. She can take four more points of Flaws, with Virtues to match.
fixes: The page's "Frosty Breath of the Stoken Lie" is Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie (Chapter Nine).
The page drops Perception's score ("Per + Pre +1"): +4 (+3 bought, then Great Perception) is the only score that spends exactly the 10 points Improved Characteristics allows.

entries.name: Jerbiton
entries.notes: Took Puissant Music as his free House Virtue: a social artist in music and magic. He can take up to three more points of Flaws, with Virtues to match. The Gentle Gift lets him deal with mundanes without penalty.
fixes: The page drops Perception's score ("Per + Pre +1"): +1 is the only score that spends exactly the 10 points Improved Characteristics allows.

entries.name: Mercere
entries.notes: Can take three more points of Flaws and Virtues. Happy to travel alone; moving Hunt and Stealth into social Abilities makes him likelier to travel in company.

entries.name: Merinita
entries.notes: Can take three more points of Flaws and Virtues. The kind of Strong Faerie Blood changes easily; she may look younger than 25.

entries.name: Tremere
entries.notes: Can take three more points of Flaws and Virtues. A social and political creature; one of those Abilities could become a Martial one. Elemental Magic makes his element Arts hard to rearrange (started at Aq 3, Au 6, Ig 6, Te 6 before its bonus xp).

entries.name: Tytalus
entries.notes: Can take up to three more points of Flaws and Virtues.
fixes: The page lists Aura of Rightful Authority twice; it is recorded once.

entries.name: Verditius

abilities.name: Awareness
abilities.specialty: flaws in stone and metal work

entries.notes: Can take three more Minor Flaws or one Major, with Virtues to match. Her Crafts can change without changing the concept, and Dwarf can be swapped for another Flaw (not every dwarf-blooded magus is small).
